response.what_it_is: Used vehicle automatic or manual transmission/gearbox assembly with attached wiring harness and lines
visible_condition: dirty with oil and grease residue
surface rust on metal brackets and components
hidden_risks: internal gear, bearing, or clutch pack wear
presence of internal debris or fluid contamination
functional working condition and exact vehicle compatibility unverified
response.best_proof: A clear, close-up photograph of the manufacturer part number stamp or identification plate
response.failure_mode: Assuming the gearbox is in good working order or correctly matched to a specific engine model without being able to verify internal condition or part numbers from the exterior photos alone.
